posts.title: The Rules Chair Lost Her Own Seat. Democrats Hit 259
posts.caption:
Central Valley governance. Merced County spending. Administrative accountability.

The Rules chair lost her own seat. Virginia Foxx, who chairs the House Rules Committee, conceded her North Carolina race to Democrat Chuck Hubbard after a recount decided by 331 votes out of 287,000 cast. The Rules panel decides which bills reach the floor and under what terms, so losing the chair means losing the throttle on the whole chamber. The same night, Democrats reached at least 259 House seats, their largest majority since the early nineties. That is a governing margin, and it changes what the next Congress can actually pass. Power is not the title you hold. It is the gate you control.

posts.caption:
